paragraphs: R' Yochanan ben Pazi. Mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, Parah, section 6.[^1]

notes.text: פ׳ פרה ס״ו is read contextually as Parah, section 6, rather than the number 66. No named edition or modern chapter 14 is independently verified or substituted. The supplied heading בן פזי is retained despite the earlier catalog stem בן כו׳; the personal title remains R'.
